finding: After query first failure, receipt rejection returned a later InvalidArgument when packet delivery was abandoned.
fix: Resolve prior query status during non-retryable receipt rejection; preserve the original InvalidArgument when no prior failure exists.

red.observation: Actual QuotaExceeded was masked as InvalidArgument; red stopped at first case.

green.coverage: QuotaExceeded and WorkerLost full error fields; no prior error retains InvalidArgument.

limitations: Synthetic in-process scenarios; no exhaustive concurrency, full workspace, production IPC, HostLab or performance qualification. Red test source was subsequently expanded with a no-prior case. Listed source hashes alone do not fix every transitive input.
